verdict.rationale: Pipecat's core is an open-source (BSD-2) Python framework that a runtime probe confirmed is pip-installable and self-hostable, and its docs describe the same bot file as portable to "most production self-hosting setups". Community reports add that fully local inference via Ollama and Whisper works. missing for 10: an in-depth first-party production self-hosting guide in the evidence (the dev runner is explicitly not for production use).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: the open-source voice-agent framework is real, pip-installable, and self-hostable
Open source Python framework for building voice and multimodal AI pipelines.
This is the property that makes the same bot file portable across the development runner, Pipecat Cloud, and most production self-hosting setups.
Local inference is already supported via Pipecat, you can use ollama or any custom OpenAI endpoint.
